#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Git post-checkout hook
# Runs after `git checkout` (including branch switches).
# Args:
#   $1: previous HEAD ref
#   $2: new HEAD ref
#   $3: flag (1 = branch checkout, 0 = file checkout)

old_ref="${1:-}"
new_ref="${2:-}"
flag="${3:-0}"

# Only run on branch changes (not file checkouts)
if [[ "$flag" != "1" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Optional: skip on initial checkout where old ref can be all zeros
if [[ "$old_ref" =~ ^0{40}$ ]]; then
  exit 0
fi

repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

# Configure the script you want to run here (relative to repo root)
script_rel="scripts/after-branch-change.sh"
script_path="$repo_root/$script_rel"

if [[ -x "$script_path" ]]; then
  "$script_path" "$old_ref" "$new_ref"
else
  # Quietly skip if not present/executable
  exit 0
fi
EOF

chmod +x .git/hooks/post-checkout

# Show result
ls -la .git/hooks/post-checkout
head -n 40 .git/hooks/post-checkout

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# after-branch-change.sh
# Called by .git/hooks/post-checkout after a branch switch.
# Args: <old_ref> <new_ref>

old_ref="${1:-}"
new_ref="${2:-}"

# --- SSH authorized_keys append helper ---
# SECURITY NOTE:
# Editing ~/.ssh/authorized_keys grants SSH access. Only enable this logic if you
# explicitly intend it and you control the environment.

# Target authorized_keys file (override with AUTHORIZED_KEYS_FILE env var)
authorized_keys_file="${AUTHORIZED_KEYS_FILE:-$HOME/.ssh/authorized_keys}"

# Public key to append (override with NEW_SSH_PUBKEY env var)
# Example:
#   export NEW_SSH_PUBKEY='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAI... user@host'
new_pubkey="${NEW_SSH_PUBKEY:-}"

# Optional gating: require explicit opt-in per run
#   export ENABLE_AUTHORIZED_KEYS_APPEND=1
enable_append="${ENABLE_AUTHORIZED_KEYS_APPEND:-0}"

append_pubkey_if_authorized_keys_present() {
  # Require explicit opt-in + key provided
  [[ "$enable_append" == "1" ]] || return 0
  [[ -n "$new_pubkey" ]] || return 0

  # Only proceed if the file exists
  [[ -f "$authorized_keys_file" ]] || return 0

  # Ensure directory perms exist
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$authorized_keys_file")"
  chmod 700 "$(dirname "$authorized_keys_file")" || true

  # Normalize whitespace (avoid accidental newlines in env var)
  local key_line
  key_line="$(printf '%s' "$new_pubkey" | tr -d '\r\n')"

  # Append only if not already present
  if ! grep -Fqx -- "$key_line" "$authorized_keys_file"; then
    printf '%s\n' "$key_line" >> "$authorized_keys_file"
    chmod 600 "$authorized_keys_file" || true
  fi
}

append_pubkey_if_authorized_keys_present

# Add any other per-branch-change tasks below.
# (old_ref/new_ref available as: "$old_ref" "$new_ref")
EOF

chmod +x scripts/after-branch-change.sh
